section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the instruments used to assess multiple constructs in a study of women. The Body Appreciation Scale (BAS; 13 items) was used to assess body appreciation, the Body Esteem Scale (BES) was used to measure attitudes toward body appearance and functioning, and additional measures assessed exercise behavior, body-related talk, and body orientation. No demographic characteristics, sample size, or correlation data are provided in this section.

section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measures used in a single study to assess exercise behavior, body orientation (using the Body Esteem Scale with body-as-process and body-as-object subscales), body appreciation (using the Body Appreciation Scale), and body-related talk (exercise talk and weight-loss talk). Table 1 presents descriptive statistics and intercorrelations for all variables, showing a correlation of -0.36 between BMI and body appreciation.
